methods: Calculated SHA-256 hashes and page counts for every supplied file and compared every distinct hash with all published catalogs.
Read all embedded PDF text and applied GPU-backed OCR to every added page with fewer than 40 normalized embedded characters.
Rendered and visually inspected the relevant report pages before recording any dollar amount or facility-table value.
Kept audited budget variances separate from total revenue, delivery quantities, invoices and receiving logs; kept the third-party DEHP compilation separate from PFAS and route proof.

queueDecision: No request is closed. The records add aggregate financial and non-PFAS technical context but do not supply per-load delivery history, receiving logs, invoices, executed agreements, an exact cessation record, synchronized PFAS treatment samples or a site-specific migration pathway.
